einzeiler: Founder Ben Goodwin helps small business owners solve real-world challenges.
kurzfassung: Guy Raz hosts an advice episode featuring Olipop co-founder Ben Goodwin, who shares insights on building a $2 billion beverage brand. Together, they troubleshoot business challenges for three callers running a organic ghee snack brand, a gluten-free bakery, and a community grocery co-op. The discussion covers bootstrapping strategies, handling perishability, retail distribution, and staying true to a core mission.
stichpunkte: Ben Goodwin shares the strategy behind Olipop's recent brand refresh, sonic identity, and fiber education campaign.
Olipop operates entirely as a remote team with around 280 employees and no central headquarters.
Goodwin emphasizes holding the company mission as a North Star rather than compromising quality for acquisition offers.
First caller Darren Alpert discusses bootstrapping his organic ghee snack brand, Gielish, to 4,000 stores.
Goodwin advises snack brands to focus primarily on taste and clear comparative nutritional benefits rather than complex ingredient education.
Second caller Sarah Godfrey seeks advice on scaling her fresh, allergen-free baked goods without relying on freezers or outside debt.
Goodwin and Raz recommend testing local partnerships and evaluating risk tolerance before taking on commercial kitchen costs or debt.
Third caller John Groner describes his work reviving the 50-year-old Bexley Natural Market co-op in Ohio.
Goodwin and Raz suggest focusing on in-store community events and product curation rather than expensive e-commerce websites.
beschreibung:
Today’s callers: Darin from North Carolina seeks guidance on consumer education as his ghee-based snack brand grows into major retailers. Then Sarah from Massachusetts explores scaling pathways for her ‘never-frozen’ gluten-free baked goods. And John from Ohio considers whether online sales can turn around his local food co-op.
Plus, Ben comments on the drivers of Olipop’s nearly $2 billion valuation, and critiques a common piece of business advice that often holds founders back.
Thank you to the founders of Gheelish, Sarah’s Gluten Free Goods, and Bexley’s Natural Foods for being a part of our show.
